mapper.sql: ( SELECT FC.CONTRACT_ID, FC.CONTRACT_NAME, FC.CONTRACT_NUMBER, FC.APPROVAL_NUMBER, 'FCT_CONTRACT' CON_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY, ( SELECT MAX(BM.BP_NAME) FROM FCT_PROJECT_BP PB JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER BM ON PB.BP_ID=BM.BP_ID WHERE PB.BP_ROLE_TYPE='SELLER' AND PB.PROJECT_ID=FC.PROJECT_ID) SAL_BP_NAME, ( SELECT MAX(BM.BP_NAME) FROM FCT_PROJECT_BP PB JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER BM ON PB.BP_ID=BM.BP_ID WHERE PB.BP_ROLE_TYPE='BUYER' AND PB.PROJECT_ID=FC.PROJECT_ID) BUY_BP_NAME, CA.QUOTATION_CASHFLOW_ID CASHFLOW_ID, CA.CF_ITEM, CA.TIMES, CA.DUE_DATE, CA.OVERDUE_STATUS, nvl(CA.DUE_AMOUNT,0) DUE_AMOUNT, nvl(CA.DUE_AMOUNT,0)-nvl(CA.RECEIVED_AMOUNT,0) UNCOLLECTED_DUE_AMOUNT, CASE WHEN CA.CF_ITEM=54 THEN nvl(CA.DUE_AMOUNT,0)-nvl(CA.RECEIVED_AMOUNT,0) ELSE 0 END UNCOLLECTED_PRINCIPAL, CASE WHEN CA.CF_ITEM=55 THEN nvl(CA.DUE_AMOUNT,0)-nvl(CA.RECEIVED_AMOUNT,0) ELSE 0 END UNCOLLECTED_INTEREST, CASE WHEN CA.CF_ITEM=54 THEN nvl(CA.DUE_AMOUNT,0) ELSE 0 END PRINCIPAL, CASE WHEN CA.CF_ITEM=55 THEN nvl(CA.DUE_AMOUNT,0) ELSE 0 END INTEREST, FC.PRE_CLEAN_TOTAL_MONEY, FC.PRE_SERVICE_CHARGE FROM FCT_CONTRACT FC JOIN FCT_QUOTATION_CASHFLOW CA ON FC.CONTRACT_ID=CA.CONTRACT_ID WHERE FC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND CA.CF_STATUS = 'RELEASE' AND CA.CF_DIRECTION = 'INFLOW' AND CA.CF_ITEM IN(54,55,11) UNION SELECT FC.CONTRACT_ID, FC.CONTRACT_NAME, FC.CONTRACT_NUMBER, PP.APPROVAL_NUMBER, 'CON_CONTRACT' CON_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY, ( SELECT MAX(BM.BP_NAME) FROM PRJ_PROJECT_BP PB JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER BM ON PB.BP_ID=BM.BP_ID WHERE PB.BP_CATEGROY='CON_CONTRACT' AND PB.BP_TYPE='TENANT' AND PB.PROJECT_ID=FC.PROJECT_ID) SAL_BP_NAME, ( SELECT MAX(BM.BP_NAME) FROM PRJ_PROJECT_BP PB JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER BM ON PB.BP_ID=BM.BP_ID WHERE PB.BP_CATEGROY='CON_CONTRACT' AND PB.BP_TYPE='TENANT_SEC' AND PB.PROJECT_ID=FC.PROJECT_ID) BUY_BP_NAME, CA.CASHFLOW_ID, CA.CF_ITEM, CA.TIMES, CA.DUE_DATE, CA.OVERDUE_STATUS, nvl(CA.DUE_AMOUNT,0) DUE_AMOUNT, nvl(CA.DUE_AMOUNT,0)-nvl(CA.RECEIVED_AMOUNT,0) UNCOLLECTED_DUE_AMOUNT, nvl(CA.PRINCIPAL,0)-nvl(CA.RECEIVED_PRINCIPAL,0) UNCOLLECTED_PRINCIPAL, nvl(CA.INTEREST,0)-nvl(CA.RECEIVED_INTEREST,0) UNCOLLECTED_INTEREST, nvl(CA.PRINCIPAL,0) PRINCIPAL, nvl(CA.INTEREST,0) INTEREST, FC.PRE_CLEAN_TOTAL_MONEY, FC.PRE_SERVICE_CHARGE FROM CON_CONTRACT FC JOIN PRJ_PROJECT PP ON PP.PROJECT_ID=FC.PROJECT_ID JOIN CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CA ON FC.CONTRACT_ID=CA.CONTRACT_ID WHERE FC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND CA.CF_STATUS = 'RELEASE' AND CA.CF_DIRECTION = 'INFLOW' AND CA.CF_ITEM IN (1,11) )
mapper.select:
SELECT PACK.*, ( CASE WHEN PACK.OVERDUE_STATUS > 0 THEN '是' ELSE '否' END ) OVERDUE_STATUS_N , UNCOLLECTED_PRINCIPAL + UNCOLLECTED_INTEREST + UNCOLLECTED_OTHER_AMOUNT as UNCOLLECTED_DUE_AMOUNT FROM (SELECT caap.PACKAGE_ID, caap.PACK_ID, caap.CONTRACT_ID, cc.CONTRACT_NUMBER, cc.CONTRACT_NAME, SAL_BP_NAME.SAL_BP_NAME, BUY_BP_NAME.BUY_BP_NAME, to_char(caap.pack_date_from,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pack_date_from, to_char(caap.pack_date_to,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pack_date_to, to_char(caap.pack_date_from,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pack_date_from_n, to_char(caap.pack_date_to,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pack_date_to_n, nvl( ( SELECT SUM( nvl( CA.DUE_AMOUNT, 0 ) - nvl( CA.RECEIVED_AMOUNT, 0 ) ) FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CA WHERE CA.CONTRACT_ID = CAAP.CONTRACT_ID AND CA.CF_ITEM = 52 ), 0 ) - nvl( ( SELECT nvl( SUM( CA.DUE_AMOUNT ), 0 ) - nvl( SUM( CA.RECEIVED_AMOUNT ), 0 ) FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CA WHERE CA.CF_ITEM = 14 AND CA.CONTRACT_ID = CAAP.CONTRACT_ID ), 0 ) AS SURPLUS_DEPOSIT_AMOUNT, nvl(( SELECT sum( nvl( ccc.PRINCIPAL, 0 ) ) FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc WHERE ccc.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID and ccc.cf_status = 'RELEASE' AND ccc.CF_ITEM = 1 AND ccc.DUE_DATE >= caap.PACK_DATE_FROM AND ccc.DUE_DATE <= caap.PACK_DATE_TO AND caap.PACK_DATE_FROM IS NOT NULL AND caap.PACK_DATE_TO IS NOT NULL ),0) AS UNCOLLECTED_PRINCIPAL, nvl(( SELECT sum( nvl( ccc.INTEREST, 0 ) ) FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc WHERE ccc.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID AND ccc.CF_ITEM = 1 and ccc.cf_status = 'RELEASE' AND ccc.DUE_DATE >= caap.PACK_DATE_FROM AND ccc.DUE_DATE <= caap.PACK_DATE_TO AND caap.PACK_DATE_FROM IS NOT NULL AND caap.PACK_DATE_TO IS NOT NULL ),0) AS UNCOLLECTED_INTEREST, nvl( ( SELECT SUM( nvl( ccc.due_amount, 0 ) ) FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc WHERE ccc.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID and ccc.cf_status = 'RELEASE' AND ccc.CF_ITEM = 51 AND ccc.DUE_DATE >= caap.PACK_DATE_FROM AND ccc.DUE_DATE <= caap.PACK_DATE_TO AND caap.PACK_DATE_FROM IS NOT NULL AND caap.PACK_DATE_TO IS NOT NULL ), 0 ) AS UNCOLLECTED_DEPOSIT, nvl( ( SELECT SUM( nvl( ccc.due_amount, 0 ) ) FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc WHERE ccc.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID and ccc.cf_status = 'RELEASE' AND ccc.CF_ITEM = 3 AND ccc.DUE_DATE >= caap.PACK_DATE_FROM AND ccc.DUE_DATE <= caap.PACK_DATE_TO AND caap.PACK_DATE_FROM IS NOT NULL AND caap.PACK_DATE_TO IS NOT NULL ), 0 ) AS UNCOLLECTED_CHARGE, nvl(( SELECT sum( nvl( ccc.DUE_AMOUNT, 0 ) ) FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc WHERE ccc.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID AND ccc.CF_DIRECTION = 'INFLOW' and ccc.cf_status = 'RELEASE' AND CCC.CF_ITEM NOT IN ( 1, 51 ,3) AND ccc.DUE_DATE >= caap.PACK_DATE_FROM AND ccc.DUE_DATE <= caap.PACK_DATE_TO AND caap.PACK_DATE_FROM IS NOT NULL AND caap.PACK_DATE_TO IS NOT NULL ),0) AS UNCOLLECTED_OTHER_AMOUNT , ( SELECT nvl( SUM( CASE WHEN CA.OVERDUE_STATUS = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CA WHERE CC.CONTRACT_ID = CA.CONTRACT_ID AND CA.DUE_DATE >= caap.PACK_DATE_FROM AND CA.DUE_DATE <= caap.PACK_DATE_TO AND caap.PACK_DATE_FROM is not null AND caap.PACK_DATE_TO is not null ) AS OVERDUE_STATUS FROM ct_abs_assets_package caap LEFT JOIN con_contract cc ON caap.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PB.PROJECT_ID, wm_concat( BM.BP_NAME ) AS SAL_BP_NAME FROM PRJ_PROJECT_BP PB JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER BM ON PB.BP_ID = BM.BP_ID WHERE PB.BP_TYPE = 'TENANT' GROUP BY PB.PROJECT_ID ) SAL_BP_NAME ON SAL_BP_NAME.PROJECT_ID = CC.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PB.PROJECT_ID, wm_concat( BM.BP_NAME ) AS BUY_BP_NAME FROM PRJ_PROJECT_BP PB JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER BM ON PB.BP_ID = BM.BP_ID WHERE PB.BP_TYPE = 'TENANT_SEC' GROUP BY PB.PROJECT_ID ) BUY_BP_NAME ON BUY_BP_NAME.PROJECT_ID = CC.PROJECT_ID ) PACK WHERE 1=1
AND PACK.PACK_ID = #{packId}

select PACK.* -- ( CASE WHEN PACK.OVERDUE_STATUS > 0 THEN '是' ELSE '否' END ) OVERDUE_STATUS_N from (SELECT CC.CONTRACT_ID, CC.CONTRACT_NAME, CC.CONTRACT_NUMBER, PP.APPROVAL_NUMBER, 'CON_CONTRACT' AS CON_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY, SAL_BP_NAME.SAL_BP_NAME, BUY_BP_NAME.BUY_BP_NAME, ( SELECT nvl( SUM( CASE WHEN CA.OVERDUE_STATUS = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CA WHERE CC.CONTRACT_ID = CA.CONTRACT_ID ) AS OVERDUE_STATUS, (select to_char(cap.BASE_DATE_FROM ,'YYYY-MM-DD') from ct_abs_assets_pack cap where cap.PACK_ID = #{packId}) as pack_date_from, (select to_char(cap.BASE_DATE_FROM ,'YYYY-MM-DD') from ct_abs_assets_pack cap where cap.PACK_ID = #{packId}) as pack_date_from_n, (select to_char(cap.BASE_DATE_TO ,'YYYY-MM-DD') from ct_abs_assets_pack cap where cap.PACK_ID = #{packId}) as pack_date_to, (select to_char(cap.BASE_DATE_TO ,'YYYY-MM-DD') from ct_abs_assets_pack cap where cap.PACK_ID = #{packId}) as pack_date_to_n FROM CON_CONTRACT CC JOIN PRJ_PROJECT PP ON PP.PROJECT_ID = CC.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PB.PROJECT_ID, wm_concat( BM.BP_NAME ) AS SAL_BP_NAME FROM PRJ_PROJECT_BP PB JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER BM ON PB.BP_ID = BM.BP_ID WHERE PB.BP_TYPE = 'TENANT' GROUP BY PB.PROJECT_ID ) SAL_BP_NAME ON SAL_BP_NAME.PROJECT_ID = CC.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PB.PROJECT_ID, wm_concat( BM.BP_NAME ) AS BUY_BP_NAME FROM PRJ_PROJECT_BP PB JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER BM ON PB.BP_ID = BM.BP_ID WHERE PB.BP_TYPE = 'TENANT_SEC' GROUP BY PB.PROJECT_ID ) BUY_BP_NAME ON BUY_BP_NAME.PROJECT_ID = CC.PROJECT_ID WHERE CC.DATA_CLASS = 'NORMAL' AND CC.CONTRACT_STATUS = 'INCEPT')PACK WHERE 1=1
AND PACK.CONTRACT_NUMBER like concat('%',concat(#{contractNumber},'%'))
AND PACK.SAL_BP_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{salBpName},'%'))
AND PACK.OCCUPY_LINE_STATUS = #{occupyLineStatus}

SELECT PACK.*, nvl(LON.CONTRACT_NUMBER,PJ.PROJECT_NUMBER) OCCUPY_DOCUMENT, nvl(LON.EXTRA_NAM,PJ.PROJECT_SHORT_NAME) OCCUPY_MAJOR_NAME, nvl(FC.CONTRACT_NUMBER,CC.CONTRACT_NUMBER) CONTRACT_NUMBER, nvl(FC.APPROVAL_NUMBER,NULL) APPROVAL_NUMBER FROM CT_ABS_ASSETS_PACKAGE PACK LEFT JOIN FCT_CONTRACT FC ON FC.CONTRACT_ID=PACK.CONTRACT_ID AND PACK.CON_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY='FCT_CONTRACT' LEFT JOIN CON_CONTRACT CC ON CC.CONTRACT_ID=PACK.CONTRACT_ID AND PACK.CON_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY='CON_CONTRACT' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P.PLEDGE_DOC_ID, P.PLEDGE_DOC_CATEGORY , MAX(L.CONTRACT_NUMBER) CONTRACT_NUMBER, MAX(M.EXTRA_NAM) EXTRA_NAM FROM CT_LON_CONTRACT_PLEDGE P, LON_CONTRACT L, HLS_BP_MASTER M WHERE P.CONTRACT_ID=L.CONTRACT_ID AND M.BP_ID=L.CREDIT_BP_ID AND P.PLEDGE_RELEASE_FLAG='Y' AND L.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' GROUP BY P.PLEDGE_DOC_ID, P.PLEDGE_DOC_CATEGORY) LON ON LON.PLEDGE_DOC_ID=PACK.CONTRACT_ID AND LON.PLEDGE_DOC_CATEGORY=PACK.CON_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY LEFT JOIN CT_ABS_PROJECT PJ ON PJ.PACK_ID=PACK.PACK_ID AND PJ.PROJECT_STATUS IN ('APPROVING', 'APPROVED') WHERE nvl(LON.CONTRACT_NUMBER,PJ.PROJECT_NUMBER) IS NOT NULL
AND PACK.PACK_ID = #{packId}

SELECT (@i :=@i + 1) as SORTORDER, TEMP.* FROM ( SELECT CON.CONTRACT_ID, MAX(CON.CONTRACT_NUMBER) CONTRACT_NUMBER, MAX(CON.APPROVAL_NUMBER) APPROVAL_NUMBER, MAX(CON.SAL_BP_NAME) SAL_BP_NAME, MAX(CON.BUY_BP_NAME) BUY_BP_NAME, CON.TIMES, MAX(CON.DUE_DATE) DUE_DATE, SUM(CON.DUE_AMOUNT) DUE_AMOUNT, SUM(CON.PRINCIPAL) PRINCIPAL, SUM(CON.INTEREST) INTEREST, SUM(CON.UNCOLLECTED_DUE_AMOUNT) UNCOLLECTED_DUE_AMOUNT, SUM(CON.UNCOLLECTED_PRINCIPAL) UNCOLLECTED_PRINCIPAL, SUM(CON.UNCOLLECTED_INTEREST) UNCOLLECTED_INTEREST FROM CT_ABS_ASSETS_PACKAGE CAAP JOIN CON ON CAAP.CONTRACT_ID=CON.CONTRACT_ID AND CAAP.CON_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY=CON.CON_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY AND CAAP.TIMES_FROM <=CON.TIMES AND CAAP.TIMES_TO >=CON.TIMES WHERE CON.DUE_DATE>= #{startDateStr} AND CON.DUE_DATE<= #{endDateStr} AND CAAP.PACK_ID=#{packId} GROUP BY CON.CONTRACT_ID,CON.TIMES ORDER BY CON.TIMES ) TEMP,(SELECT @i := 0) AS row_seq

SELECT PACK.* FROM ( SELECT CAAP.PACKAGE_ID, CAAP.PACK_ID, CAAP.CONTRACT_ID, CAAP.CON_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY, CAAP.TIMES_FROM, CAAP.TIMES_TO, CAAP.DESCRIPTION, CON.CONTRACT_NAME, CON.CONTRACT_NUMBER, CON.APPROVAL_NUMBER, CON.PRE_CLEAN_TOTAL_MONEY, CON.PRE_SERVICE_CHARGE, CON.UNCOLLECTED_DUE_AMOUNT FROM CT_ABS_ASSETS_PACKAGE CAAP JOIN ( SELECT FC.CONTRACT_ID, FC.CONTRACT_NAME, FC.CONTRACT_NUMBER, FC.APPROVAL_NUMBER, 'FCT_CONTRACT' CON_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY, FC.PRE_CLEAN_TOTAL_MONEY, FC.PRE_SERVICE_CHARGE, nvl(fc.RESIDUAL_INTEREST,0)+nvl(fc.RESIDUAL_PRINCIPAL ,0) UNCOLLECTED_DUE_AMOUNT FROM FCT_CONTRACT FC
WHERE FC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' UNION ALL SELECT FC.CONTRACT_ID, FC.CONTRACT_NAME, FC.CONTRACT_NUMBER, PP.APPROVAL_NUMBER, 'CON_CONTRACT' CON_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY, FC.PRE_CLEAN_TOTAL_MONEY, FC.PRE_SERVICE_CHARGE, nvl(fc.RESIDUAL_INTEREST,0)+nvl(fc.RESIDUAL_PRINCIPAL ,0) UNCOLLECTED_DUE_AMOUNT FROM CON_CONTRACT FC JOIN PRJ_PROJECT PP ON PP.PROJECT_ID=FC.PROJECT_ID WHERE FC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' ) CON ON CAAP.CONTRACT_ID=CON.CONTRACT_ID AND CAAP.CON_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY=CON.CON_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY WHERE 1=1
) PACK WHERE 1=1
AND PACK.PACK_ID = #{packId}
and PACK.CONTRACT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{contractName},'%'))
and PACK.CONTRACT_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{contractNumber},'%'))
and PACK.APPROVAL_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{approvalNumber},'%'))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CT_ABS_ASSETS_PACKAGE CAAP WHERE CAAP.PACKAGE_ID NOT IN ( SELECT CF.PACKAGE_ID FROM CT_ABS_CONTRACT_FINISH CF) AND CAAP.PACK_ID = #{packId}
mapper.select: SELECT CHANGE_PAG.* FROM CT_ABS_ASSETS_PACKAGE CHANGE_PAG LEFT JOIN CT_ABS_ASSETS_PACKAGE NORMAL_PAG ON CHANGE_PAG.REF_PACKAGE_ID=NORMAL_PAG.PACKAGE_ID WHERE (CHANGE_PAG.REF_PACKAGE_ID IS NULL OR ( CHANGE_PAG.REF_PACKAGE_ID NOT IN (SELECT CF.PACKAGE_ID FROM CT_ABS_CONTRACT_FINISH CF) ) ) AND CHANGE_PAG.PACK_ID = #{packId}

SELECT CASE WHEN ( SELECT nvl( SUM( CASE WHEN CA.OVERDUE_STATUS = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CA WHERE CA.CONTRACT_ID = #{contractId} AND CA.DUE_DATE >= #{packDateFrom} AND CA.DUE_DATE <= #{packDateTo} ) > 0 THEN'是' ELSE '否' END AS OVERDUE_STATUS_N
